s1.title: Don't Bother Dating Unless You're Ripped
s1.hook: If you're a little fat, women swipe left before they ever see your personality.
s1.body:
Over 70% of people are meeting on dating apps or online now, and in online dating, looks are paramount. If you look a little sloppy, especially if you're also short like me, they swipe left. They never see your personality. They never see how much money you have. Nothing matters except the way you look.

It's only once you crack into the top 10% best looking guys that women are even open to knowing who you are. I was in decent shape before, then I got in really good shape, and it 10x'd my matches.

The modern dating environment is winner take all. The guys at the top are taking everything. The bottom 80% are getting nothing.
s1.close: Leave a comment and tell me if your matches went up when you got in shape.
s1.pinned_comment: Did your matches go up when you got in better shape?

s3.title: You Can't Afford To NOT Work Out
s3.hook: Money doesn't do you any good if you're dead.
s3.body:
A lot of people think they can live with average or mediocre health as long as they have a little more money. That is totally wrong thinking. If you have millions of dollars and you just pass it on to your heirs, you did not benefit from it at all. Your life was a waste if you spent it all working and didn't live long enough to spend the money.

People justify being slaves to their job or their business by saying their kids will benefit. I really don't think they will. On both sides of my family, my grandparents' families started suing each other and wasted more money on the legal fight than they inherited.

That's probably what happens to your money too if you leave a big pile behind and die early because you neglected your health.
s3.close: Leave a comment and tell me if you're trading your health for money right now.
